title: 出口猛增35%：内需却更弱，刺激影响为何还没到？
speaker: Helen Qiao

segments.en: Well, I think the numbers were not necessarily too surprising. We were just saying that I was expecting export being so still so strong, 35% plus growth.
segments.zh: 我觉得这些数字不一定太意外。我们刚说，我预计出口仍会强劲，增长35%以上。

segments.en: That was impressive last week. But at the same time, all IP fixats at investment and retail sales on the domestic demand side seems to be pretty weak.
segments.zh: 上周令人印象深刻。但与此同时，内需方面的工业增加值、固定资产**和零售销售似乎相当疲弱。

segments.en: And especially, if you think about IP, it is below expectation.
segments.zh: 尤其是工业增加值，低于预期。

segments.en: And at the same time, even supported at least by 30%, 40% of very strong, very fast-growing exports still
segments.zh: 同时，即使至少有30%、40%非常强劲、快速增长的出口支撑，

segments.en: came in at such low levels. That implies the domestic demand part of the industrial activities must have been much weaker.
segments.zh: 仍处于如此低的水平。这意味着工业活动中的内需部分一定弱得多。

segments.en: So I would say this is pretty much the same old stuff.
segments.zh: 所以我说这基本是老样子。

segments.en: Despite the stimulus tab has opened.
segments.zh: 尽管刺激计划已经开启。

segments.en: So this is quite interesting. Guess we are still probably in the waiting time for the stimulus impact to kick in.
segments.zh: 这很有趣。看来我们可能仍在等待刺激效果显现。
